cards.description: 该研究在无泄漏的前向滚动设计下检验随机矩阵理论、Tsallis尾指数、Hawkes自激强度与扩散型正则化等经济物理工具，能否为神经网络一日前协方差预测带来增量价值。其价值在于用严格泄漏控制、嵌套滚动验证与多随机种子，给出对这些常被提议组件的可复现负面证据。
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions are limited to 29 Dow constituents, 545 trading days, 1-minute frequency and a one-day horizon, and do not extend to other assets, markets, frequencies or longer horizons. The negative results pertain to a specific PINC implementation, hyperparameter search and validation pipeline; other constructions of econophysics features are not ruled out. Portfolio conclusions are limited to Sharpe ratio tests after transaction costs.
cards.summaryEn: The study builds the PINC framework to forecast one-day-ahead covariance using 1-minute data for 29 Dow constituents over 545 trading days, evaluated with 11 nested walk-forward folds, 231 out-of-sample trading days and multiple random seeds. Factually, neural models beat static estimators such as sample, Ledoit-Wolf, RMT and EVT, but show no statistically significant gain over HAR-RV or LSTM benchmarks; validation consistently rejects the physics-inspired regularizer, and ablations find no measurable contribution from RMT, Tsallis or Hawkes features. The authors conclude that, for this dataset and horizon, econophysics-inspired components provide no measurable benefit beyond strong financial benchmarks.
cards.limitations: 结论仅基于29只道指成分股、545个交易日、1分钟频率和一日预测期，不能外推到其他资产、市场、频率或更长预测期。负面结果针对特定PINC实现、超参数搜索与验证流程，不排除其他构造方式下经济物理特征仍有效；组合结论以扣除交易成本后的夏普比率检验为限。
keyPoints: 神经协方差模型优于样本、Ledoit-Wolf、RMT与EVT等静态估计器，但未统计显著超越HAR-RV和LSTM基准。
验证数据一致拒绝Fokker-Planck式正则项，消融显示RMT、Tsallis与Hawkes特征无可测贡献。
组合实验在扣除交易成本后，夏普比率的提升不具统计显著性。
cards.title: 经济物理启发输入未提升神经协方差预测
cards.whyItMatters: 对量化研究而言，这项研究把“经济物理特征是否有增量信息”置于可复现的滚动外样本检验中，提示在引入复杂物理启发模块前应先与强金融基准和消融分析对照，避免把基准能力误归因于新特征。
cards.summary: 研究构建PINC框架，用29只道指成分股545个交易日的1分钟数据做一日前协方差预测，并在11折嵌套滚动、231个样本外交易日和多随机种子上评估。事实层面，神经模型优于样本、Ledoit-Wolf、RMT和EVT等静态协方差估计器，但相对HAR-RV或LSTM基准无统计显著改进；验证一致拒绝物理启发正则项，消融未发现RMT、Tsallis或Hawkes特征的贡献。作者据此认为，在该数据集与预测期上，经济物理启发组件相较强金融基准无可测收益。
cards.originalTitle: Do Econophysics-Inspired Inputs Improve Neural Covariance Forecasting? A Leakage-Free Walk-Forward Study of Intraday DJIA Data
cards.titleEn: Econophysics-Inspired Inputs Do Not Improve Neural Covariance Forecasting
cards.descriptionEn: The study tests whether econophysics tools—random matrix theory, Tsallis tail indices, Hawkes self-excitation and diffusion-inspired regularization—add value to neural one-day-ahead covariance forecasting under a leakage-free walk-forward design. Its value lies in providing reproducible negative evidence with strict leakage controls, nested walk-forward validation and multiple random seeds.
keyPointsEn: Neural covariance models outperform static estimators such as sample, Ledoit-Wolf, RMT and EVT, but do not significantly beat HAR-RV or LSTM benchmarks.
Validation consistently rejects the Fokker-Planck-style regularizer, and ablations show no measurable contribution from RMT, Tsallis or Hawkes features.
Portfolio experiments show no statistically significant Sharpe ratio improvement after transaction costs.
cards.whyItMattersEn: For quantitative research, the study places the question of whether econophysics features carry incremental information within a reproducible out-of-sample walk-forward test, suggesting that complex physics-inspired modules should be benchmarked against strong financial baselines and ablation analyses before attributing gains to new features.

cards.description: 该研究在零样本设定下，将九种时间序列基础模型（TSFM）与八种计量模型（含HAR族）对比，预测50种资产的已实现波动率。新发现是：TSFM整体未超越计量基准，仅最小的TTM在平均QLIKE损失上略优于Log-HAR；模型选择比模型类别更重要。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is limited to 50 assets from the VOLARE dataset, three forecast horizons, and a zero-shot setting; training or fine-tuning foundation models is not considered; TTM's edge is only a few basis points per year before trading costs, which are not accounted for; conclusions are based on QLIKE loss and MCS tests, not other loss functions or applications.
cards.summaryEn: The paper compares nine zero-shot time series foundation models with eight econometric models for realized volatility forecasting across 50 assets. Facts: foundation models as a class do not outperform econometric benchmarks; only TTM narrowly beats Log-HAR at all horizons; accuracy differs far more across foundation models than between the best foundation model and Log-HAR; equal-weight average of TTM and Log-HAR matches the best single model. The author's view: which foundation model one chooses matters more than whether one uses a foundation model or an econometric one; for a constant volatility target, TTM's edge is worth a few basis points a year before trading costs.
cards.limitations: 证据限于VOLARE数据集的50种资产、三种预测期限和零样本设定；未考虑训练或微调基础模型；TTM优势在交易成本前仅每年几个基点，未计交易成本；结论基于QLIKE损失和MCS检验，未覆盖其他损失函数或应用场景。
keyPoints: 九种零样本TSFM整体未超越八种计量基准，仅最小的TTM在1、5、22天期限上平均QLIKE损失略低于Log-HAR。
基础模型间的预测精度差异远大于最佳基础模型与Log-HAR的差异，模型选择比模型类别更关键。
TTM与Log-HAR误差模式不同，等权平均可匹配最佳单模型，并在多数资产中进入模型置信集（MCS）。
cards.title: 时间序列基础模型预测已实现波动率：零样本表现不及计量基准但TTM略优
cards.whyItMatters: 为量化研究者提供了零样本基础模型在波动率预测上的严格基准对比，提示模型选择的重要性，并展示简单组合可达到最佳单模型效果。
cards.summary: 论文比较了九种零样本时间序列基础模型与八种计量模型在50种资产已实现波动率预测上的表现。事实是：基础模型作为一个类别并未超越计量基准，仅TTM在全部预测期限上以微弱优势优于Log-HAR；基础模型之间的精度差异远大于最佳基础模型与Log-HAR的差异；TTM与Log-HAR等权平均可匹配最佳单模型。作者观点是：选择哪个基础模型比是否使用基础模型更重要；对恒定波动率目标投资者，TTM优势在交易成本前每年仅值几个基点。
cards.originalTitle: Forecasting Realized Volatility with Time Series Foundation Models: A Comparison with Econometric Benchmarks
cards.titleEn: Time Series Foundation Models for Realized Volatility Forecasting: Zero-Shot Performance Falls Short of Econometric Benchmarks but TTM Shows Sli
cards.descriptionEn: The study compares nine time series foundation models (TSFMs) in a zero-shot setting with eight econometric models (including HAR family) for forecasting realized volatility of 50 assets. New finding: TSFMs as a class do not outperform econometric benchmarks; only the smallest TTM has a narrow average QLIKE advantage over Log-HAR; model choice matters more than model class.
keyPointsEn: Nine zero-shot TSFMs as a class do not outperform eight econometric benchmarks; only the smallest TTM has a slightly lower average QLIKE loss than Log-HAR at 1-, 5-, and 22-day horizons.
Accuracy differences across foundation models far exceed the difference between the best foundation model and Log-HAR, making model choice more critical than model class.
TTM and Log-HAR make different errors; their equal-weight average matches the best single model and enters the Model Confidence Set (MCS) for most assets.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Provides quantitative researchers with a rigorous benchmark comparison of zero-shot foundation models for volatility forecasting, highlighting the importance of model selection and showing that a simple combination can match the best single model.

cards.description: 这是一条来自QuantInsti旗下Quantra平台的促销视频信息，新意不在于量化方法，而在于课程价格折扣：单课折扣80%，全部课程包折扣88%。对关注Python交易、回测、期权与机器学习课程的学习者，可用于判断是否值得在促销期购课。
cards.limitationsEn: The input is only a promotional short-video description. It provides no syllabus, instructor credentials, course length, original prices, user reviews, or learning-outcome data. The accuracy and conditions of the discount rates cannot be verified from the input, and there are no quantitative strategies or backtest results to evaluate.
cards.summaryEn: The source is a short Black Friday promotion video from Quantra, centered on course discounts: 80% off individual courses and 88% off the All Courses Bundle. Factually, only the discount rates and course areas (Python trading, backtesting, options, machine learning) are given, with no course details or effectiveness evidence. The author's stance is promotional, encouraging learners to "buy the dip and build skills"; it is not investment advice.
cards.limitations: 输入内容仅为促销短视频的简介，未提供课程大纲、讲师资质、课时、价格原值、用户评价或学习效果数据；折扣比例的真实性和适用条件无法从输入中核实；无任何量化策略或回测结果可供评估。
keyPoints: 促销信息：单课折扣80%，全部课程包折扣88%
课程方向包括Python交易、回测、期权和面向市场的机器学习
来源明确声明仅供教育用途，不构成投资建议，交易有风险
cards.title: Quantra黑色星期五课程促销信息卡
cards.whyItMatters: 对计划系统学习量化交易工具的学习者，该信息提供了一个明确的折扣窗口与课程范围参照；但适不适合买课仍取决于个人基础、课程大纲与预算，不能仅凭折扣比例判断价值。
cards.summary: 来源为Quantra黑色星期五促销短视频，主要内容是课程折扣：单课80% off、全部课程包88% off。事实层面仅提供了折扣比例和课程方向（Python交易、回测、期权、机器学习），未给出课程内容细节或效果证据。作者观点以营销为主，鼓励学习者“买跌、建技能”，不构成投资建议。
cards.originalTitle: The Dip You've Been Waiting For 📉 | Quantra Black Friday Sale
cards.titleEn: Quantra Black Friday Course Promotion: What the Info Card Covers
cards.descriptionEn: This is a promotion video description from Quantra by QuantInsti. Its novelty is not a quantitative method but course pricing: 80% off individual courses and 88% off the All Courses Bundle. Learners interested in Python trading, backtesting, options, and machine learning courses can use it to judge whether a promotional purchase is worth considering.
keyPointsEn: Promotion: 80% off individual courses and 88% off the All Courses Bundle
Course areas include Python trading, backtesting, options, and machine learning for markets
The source explicitly states educational use only, not investment advice, and that trading involves risk
cards.whyItMattersEn: For learners planning to study quantitative trading tools systematically, this provides a clear discount window and a reference for course scope. Whether to buy still depends on one's background, the syllabus, and budget; discount size alone does not indicate value.

cards.description: 本文提出基于张量分解的滤波方法，将交叉验证协方差清洗与Average Oracle方法扩展到偶数阶协矩张量，用于大规模组合中协方差与协峰度的去噪估计。其新意在于将原本用于协方差矩阵的收缩思想推广到高阶矩张量，并利用历史罗素1000成分股数据验证了样本外估计精度的提升，对组合风险管理和优化具有实用价值。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based solely on backtests using historical Russell 1000 constituents and does not cover other markets or asset classes; out-of-sample evaluation depends on the specific time period and portfolio objective; method performance may be affected by sample size, tensor order, and tuning parameters, and computational complexity and numerical stability are not discussed; conclusions do not constitute investment advice.
cards.summaryEn: Portfolio risk depends not only on return variance but also on the covariance matrix and higher-order co-moments (coskewness, cokurtosis, etc.), which are extremely noisy in large portfolios. The authors introduce filtering methods based on tensor decompositions that extend cross-validated covariance cleaning and the Average Oracle methodology to even-order co-moment tensors. Using historical Russell 1000 constituents, they report that the proposed filters improve out-of-sample estimation accuracy over sample estimators, translating into lower errors on portfolio volatility and kurtosis.
cards.limitations: 证据仅基于历史罗素1000成分股数据的回测，未涉及其他市场或资产类别；样本外评估依赖于特定时间段和组合目标设定；方法效果可能受样本量、张量阶数和调参影响，未讨论计算复杂度与数值稳定性；结论不构成投资建议。
keyPoints: 提出基于张量分解的滤波方法，将交叉验证协方差清洗与Average Oracle方法扩展到偶数阶协矩张量。
在历史罗素1000成分股数据上，所提滤波器在相关系数和协峰度张量上的样本外相对平方Frobenius误差低于样本估计量。
估计精度的提升转化为组合波动率和峰度相对误差的降低，当组合目标同时惩罚方差与四阶矩时，样本外波动率和峰度也更低。
cards.title: 非线性收缩改进大规模组合高阶矩估计
cards.whyItMatters: 大规模组合的风险管理不能仅依赖方差，高阶协矩的准确估计对控制尾部风险和优化组合目标至关重要。本文提供的滤波方法能降低高阶矩估计噪声，提升样本外精度，为实际组合构建与风险度量提供可操作的工具。
cards.summary: 组合风险不仅取决于收益方差，还依赖协方差矩阵与高阶协矩（协偏度、协峰度等），但这些对象在大规模组合中噪声极大。作者提出基于张量分解的滤波方法，将交叉验证协方差清洗和Average Oracle方法推广到偶数阶协矩张量。使用历史罗素1000成分股数据，作者报告所提滤波器在样本外估计精度上优于样本估计量，并转化为组合波动率与峰度误差的降低。
cards.originalTitle: Nonlinear Shrinkage for Higher Moments Estimation in Large Portfolios
cards.titleEn: Nonlinear Shrinkage Improves Higher-Moment Estimation for Large Portfolios
cards.descriptionEn: This paper proposes tensor-decomposition-based filtering methods that extend cross-validated covariance cleaning and the Average Oracle methodology to even-order co-moment tensors, for denoising covariance and cokurtosis estimates in large portfolios. The novelty lies in generalizing shrinkage ideas originally for covariance matrices to higher-order moment tensors, with out-of-sample accuracy improvements validated on historical Russell 1000 constituents, offering practical v
keyPointsEn: Proposes tensor-decomposition-based filtering methods extending cross-validated covariance cleaning and the Average Oracle methodology to even-order co-moment tensors.
On historical Russell 1000 constituents, the proposed filters achieve lower out-of-sample relative squared Frobenius errors than sample estimators for both correlation and cokurtosis tensors.

The estimation accuracy gains translate into lower relative errors on portfolio volatility and kurtosis, and into lower out-of-sample volatility and kurtosis when the portfolio objective penalizes both variance and the fourth moment.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Risk management for large portfolios cannot rely on variance alone; accurate estimation of higher-order co-moments is crucial for controlling tail risk and optimizing portfolio objectives. The filtering methods reduce noise in higher-moment estimates and improve out-of-sample accuracy, providing actionable tools for practical portfolio construction and risk measurement.

cards.description: 本研究检验了Jev决策模型对纳斯达克100指数未来四周下跌概率的校准情况，发现其原始预测系统性高估下跌概率，而用历史基率做先验平移可显著改善校准并提升半凯利组合收益。
cards.limitationsEn: Evaluation covers only 88 weeks from January 2025, a single asset (Nasdaq-100), and a specific question format; a knowledge probe indicates Jev's knowledge extends to late 2024, so results may be limited by the model's knowledge cutoff and sample period; the prior-shift effect needs validation over longer periods and other markets and does not constitute investment advice.
cards.summaryEn: The study tests whether the Jev decision model is calibrated on realized market outcomes and finds raw forecasts overestimate decline probability (mean 0.48 vs observed 0.38, ECE 0.10). A prior shift to the historical base rate, using no test-period outcomes, lowers ECE to 0.015 and raises half-Kelly annual return from 3.1% to 14.5%. The authors argue decision-model probabilities should be anchored to the market event base rate before position sizing, though the finding rests on 88 weeks and warrants caution in extrapolation.
cards.limitations: 评估仅覆盖2025年1月起88周、单一标的（纳斯达克100）与特定提问形式；知识探针显示Jev知识截至2024年末，结果可能受模型知识截止与样本期限制；历史基率先验平移的效果需在更长周期与其他市场上验证，不构成投资建议。
keyPoints: Jev原始预测平均下跌概率为0.48，实际频率为0.38，ECE为0.10；先验平移后ECE降至0.015。
Platt缩放、等渗回归及与马尔可夫模型组合均使预测变差。
马尔可夫模型对超过10%的大幅下跌预测较好（AUC为0.81），其策略在1999-2026年夏普比率最高。
cards.title: 决策模型在市场校准中的偏差与修正
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究提示量化组合管理中直接使用决策模型输出的概率进行仓位分配可能存在系统偏差，先用历史基率对概率做锚定修正是一种简单且无需测试期结果的改进手段。
cards.summary: 研究测试了Jev决策模型在真实市场结果上的校准性，发现其原始预测高估下跌概率（均值0.48对实际0.38，ECE为0.10）。采用不含测试期结果的历史基率先验平移后，ECE降至0.015，半凯利组合年收益从3.1%升至14.5%。作者认为决策模型概率在用于仓位管理前应锚定市场事件的基率；但该结论基于88周样本，需谨慎外推。
cards.originalTitle: Are Calibrated Decision Models Calibrated on Markets? Geolocated News, Markov Switching and a System One Model for Nasdaq-100 Allocation
cards.titleEn: Calibration Bias of Decision Models in Markets and Prior-Shift Correction
cards.descriptionEn: This study tests the calibration of the Jev decision model against realized Nasdaq-100 four-week decline outcomes, finding systematic overestimation of decline probabilities; prior shifting to the historical base rate improves calibration and half-Kelly portfolio returns.
keyPointsEn: Raw Jev forecasts average 0.48 decline probability versus 0.38 observed frequency, with ECE 0.10; prior shift lowers ECE to 0.015.
Platt scaling, isotonic regression, and combination with a Markov model all worsen forecasts.
A Markov-switching model forecasts large declines (over 10%) well, with AUC 0.81, and its strategy has the highest Sharpe ratio over 1999-2026.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study suggests that directly using decision-model probability outputs for position sizing may carry systematic bias in quantitative portfolio management, and anchoring probabilities to the historical base rate offers a simple correction requiring no test-period outcomes.

cards.description: 本文介绍Ruby，一种基于结构基础模型Pearl中间表征的稳健通用结合亲和力预测器，无需每个化合物的显式结合姿态。其新意在于在多个公开基准和专有项目数据上取得领先的早期富集和相关性表现，并发布了经审计的公开效力训练数据集。该工具有望支持从命中发现到先导优化的化合物优先级排序。
cards.limitationsEn: Ruby's training and evaluation rely mainly on proprietary data and public datasets provided by the authors; its generalization to broader chemical space and target classes requires independent validation. The zero-shot advantage is observed on five ongoing programs whose data are not public and cannot be reproduced. Inference cost is adjustable, but the actual computational expense of high-enrichment settings is not clearly quantified. Although audited, the public dataset may still carry source biases. Performance comparisons depend on the selected benchmarks and method set and do not cover all existing methods.
cards.summaryEn: Ruby predicts small-molecule potency using intermediate representations from the Pearl structural foundation model, without requiring explicit binding poses. It achieves the highest aggregate early enrichment across seven public hit-identification targets and the highest average correlations across four public benchmarks. In zero-shot prediction on data from five ongoing programs, Ruby significantly outperforms other methods and improves more when recalibrated with earlier assay measurements. The authors present Ruby as a strong tool across discovery stages and release an audited training dataset.
cards.limitations: Ruby的训练和评估主要基于作者提供的专有数据及公开数据集，其在更广泛化学空间和靶标类别上的泛化能力尚需独立验证。零样本预测优势在五个进行中项目上观察到，但这些项目数据未公开，无法复现。推理成本可调，但高富集设置的实际计算开销未明确量化。公开数据集虽经审计，仍可能受来源偏差影响。性能比较依赖于所选的基准和方法集合，未涵盖所有现有方法。
keyPoints: Ruby在七个公开命中识别靶标上取得最高聚合早期富集，推理成本可在两个数量级以上调整。
在OpenFE、CASP16、FEP+ 4和OpenBind四个公开基准上，Ruby取得最高平均相关性。
在五个进行中项目的八个生化与细胞实验中，Ruby零样本预测显著优于其他方法，且利用早期数据校准后提升更大。
cards.title: Ruby模型：利用学习到的结构表征实现跨发现阶段的效力预测
cards.whyItMatters: 小分子药物发现依赖反复的设计-制造-测试-分析循环，不同阶段对计算方法和数据的需求不同。Ruby提供了一种无需显式结合姿态的通用效力预测方法，并在公开和专有数据上展示了跨阶段优势，可能帮助 prioritization 并减少对高成本物理模拟的依赖。同时，公开审计数据集的发布有助于该领域的可重复研究。
cards.summary: Ruby利用Pearl结构基础模型的中间表征预测小分子效力，无需显式结合姿态。在七个公开命中识别靶标上，Ruby取得最高聚合早期富集，并在四个公开基准上取得最高平均相关性。在五个进行中的项目数据上，零样本预测显著优于其他方法，且利用早期实验数据校准后提升更明显。作者认为这些结果使Ruby成为跨发现阶段的有力工具，并发布了经审计的训练数据集。
cards.originalTitle: Ruby: State-of-the-Art Potency Prediction across Discovery Regimes Using Learned Structural Representations
cards.titleEn: Ruby: Learned Structural Representations Enable Potency Prediction Across Discovery Stages
cards.descriptionEn: This paper introduces Ruby, a robust universal binding affinity predictor that uses intermediate representations from the structural foundation model Pearl without requiring an explicit binding pose for every compound. Its novelty lies in achieving leading early enrichment and correlation performance across multiple public benchmarks and proprietary program data, and releasing an audited public potency training dataset. The tool may support compound prioritization from hit id
keyPointsEn: Ruby achieves the highest aggregate early enrichment across seven public hit-identification targets, with inference effort adjustable over more than two orders of magnitude.
Ruby achieves the highest average correlations across four public benchmarks: OpenFE, CASP16, FEP+ 4, and OpenBind.
In zero-shot prediction across eight biochemical and cellular assays from five ongoing programs, Ruby significantly outperforms other methods and improves more after recalibration with earlier data.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Small-molecule drug discovery relies on iterative design-make-test-analyze cycles, with different computational demands across stages. Ruby offers a general potency prediction method that does not require explicit binding poses and shows cross-stage advantages on public and proprietary data, potentially aiding prioritization and reducing reliance on costly physics-based simulations. The release of an audited public dataset also supports reproducible research in the field.

cards.description: 该研究为完全线性市场中分位数对冲问题的数值近似提供了严格的误差分析。新方法结合控制截断与分段常数策略时间步进，并连续停止控制以保持状态约束，从而推导出显式的值函数误差界。这对于理解此类数值方法的收敛速率和实际定价偏差修正具有参考价值。
cards.limitationsEn: The analysis is restricted to complete linear markets with Markovian diffusion dynamics and requires standard coefficient regularity and a Lipschitz payoff. The error exponent results rely on parameter optimization and are not guaranteed for fixed parameters. Quantification and correction of pricing bias are illustrated only via a toy problem, and performance in practical models requires further validation.
cards.summaryEn: The authors propose a numerical scheme for quantile hedging under Markovian diffusion dynamics, combining control truncation and piecewise-constant policy time-stepping. Using one-step dynamic programming and regularization, they derive a generator inequality and explicit value-function error bounds. Optimizing truncation and regularization parameters yields error exponents arbitrarily close to 1/8 (general case) or 1/4 (bounded-control case) from below.
cards.limitations: 分析限于完全线性市场与马尔可夫扩散动态，且要求标准系数正则性与 Lipschitz 支付函数。误差指数结果依赖于参数优化，并非固定参数下的保证。定价偏差的量化与修正仅通过玩具问题示例，实际模型中的表现需进一步验证。
keyPoints: 在一般情形下，优化参数可使误差指数任意接近 1/8（从下方），且关于概率变量一致。
当控制从一开始就有界时，误差指数可任意接近 1/4（从下方）。
全离散方案中网格时间投影到 [0,1] 会引入鞅缺陷和定价偏差，可通过状态依赖的控制界进行修正。
cards.title: 分位数对冲数值近似的误差分析
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作为分位数对冲的数值近似提供了理论误差保证和收敛速率分析，有助于理解实际计算中的定价偏差来源，并为设计更精确的数值方案提供依据。
cards.summary: 作者针对马尔可夫扩散模型下的分位数对冲问题，提出了结合控制截断与分段常数策略时间步进的数值方案。通过单步动态规划原理与正则化，得到了生成元不等式和显式的值函数误差界。结果表明，优化截断与正则化参数可使误差指数任意接近 1/8（一般情形）或 1/4（控制有界情形）。
cards.originalTitle: Error analysis for the numerical approximation of the quantile hedging problem
cards.titleEn: Error Analysis for Numerical Approximation of the Quantile Hedging Problem
cards.descriptionEn: This study provides a rigorous error analysis for numerical approximations of the quantile hedging problem in complete linear markets. The new approach combines control truncation with piecewise-constant policy time-stepping and continuous stopping of controls upon boundary hitting to preserve state constraints, yielding explicit value-function error bounds. This is useful for understanding convergence rates and correcting pricing biases in practical numerical methods.
keyPointsEn: In the general case, optimizing parameters yields an error exponent arbitrarily close to 1/8 from below, uniformly in the probability variable.
When controls are bounded from the outset, the error exponent can be arbitrarily close to 1/4 from below.
The fully discrete scheme with grid-time projection onto [0,1] introduces a martingale defect and pricing bias, which can be mitigated using a state-dependent control bound.
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work provides theoretical error guarantees and convergence rate analysis for numerical approximations of quantile hedging, helping to understand sources of pricing bias in practical computations and informing the design of more accurate numerical schemes.

cards.description: TabularMath 基准用程序验证的确定性计算揭示：表格模型在分布内拟合良好，但外推至训练范围外时精确答案准确率大幅下降，且增加数据无法弥补归纳偏置差距。
cards.limitationsEn: The benchmark covers only 114 programmatic tasks, mainly from GSM8K and AIME math problems, and may not represent all deterministic computation scenarios; competition-level AIME tasks remain unsolved by all methods, so generalization requires caution; no validation on real financial or physical data.
cards.summaryEn: This study introduces TabularMath, a benchmark compiling GSM8K and AIME problems into 114 deterministic computation programs (233,472 rows) to evaluate computational extrapolation of tabular models. Experiments show TabPFN v2.5 excels on regression metrics but its exact-answer accuracy falls from 39.5% to 7.8% out-of-distribution, with 16x more data improving accuracy by only 0.4 points; symbolic regression recovers all OOD answers in 72/100 GSM8K tasks. The authors argue tabular foundation models fit trends but miss computations, an inductive-bias gap that more data cannot close, and AIME tasks remain open for all methods.
cards.limitations: 基准仅涵盖 114 个程序化任务，主要来自 GSM8K 和 AIME 数学问题，未必代表所有确定性计算场景；AIME 竞赛级任务对所有方法仍无解，结论推广需谨慎；未涉及真实金融或物理数据验证。
keyPoints: TabPFN v2.5 在分布内中位 R² 达 0.999，但外推时精确答案准确率从 39.5% 降至 7.8%，70/100 GSM8K 任务全错。
增加 16 倍数据仅提升外推准确率 0.4 个百分点，表明数据量无法弥补归纳偏置。
符号回归在 72/100 GSM8K 任务中恢复所有外推答案，GPT-OSS-120B 上下文学习答对 39.2% 外推查询。
cards.title: 表格学习需从统计插值转向计算外推
cards.whyItMatters: 许多高价值表格数据（如定价规则、物理模拟）由确定性计算产生，而非噪声关系。该基准揭示当前表格模型擅长统计插值但缺乏计算外推能力，为设计具备程序归纳偏置的模型提供评估方向。
cards.summary: 该研究构建 TabularMath 基准，将 GSM8K 和 AIME 问题编译为 114 个确定性计算程序（233,472 行），用于评估表格模型的计算外推能力。实验发现，TabPFN v2.5 在回归指标上表现优异，但外推时精确答案准确率从 39.5% 降至 7.8%，且增加数据仅提升 0.4 个百分点；符号回归在 72/100 的 GSM8K 任务中恢复所有外推答案。作者认为表格基础模型拟合趋势但遗漏计算，存在数据无法弥补的归纳偏置差距，AIME 任务对所有方法仍开放。
cards.originalTitle: TabularMath: Evaluating Computational Extrapolation in Tabular Learning via Program-Verified Synthesis
cards.titleEn: Tabular Learning Needs Computational Extrapolation Beyond Statistical Interpolation
cards.descriptionEn: The TabularMath benchmark, using program-verified deterministic computations, reveals that tabular models fit in-distribution well but suffer sharp accuracy drops in exact answers when extrapolating beyond training range, and more data cannot close the inductive-bias gap.
keyPointsEn: TabPFN v2.5 achieves median R² of 0.999 in-distribution but OOD exact-answer accuracy drops from 39.5% to 7.8%, failing all queries in 70/100 GSM8K tasks.
16x more data improves OOD accuracy by only 0.4 points, indicating data volume cannot compensate for inductive bias.
Symbolic regression recovers all OOD answers in 72/100 GSM8K tasks, and GPT-OSS-120B in-context learning answers 39.2% of OOD queries.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Many high-value tabular data (e.g., pricing rules, physical simulations) are produced by deterministic computations rather than noisy relationships. This benchmark reveals that current tabular models excel at statistical interpolation but lack computational extrapolation, providing an evaluation direction for designing models with program-induction bias.

cards.description: 该研究在统一预处理和时间顺序评估流程下，比较线性回归、RNN和LSTM对标普500次日收盘价的预测，并审计文献中常见的三种结果膨胀做法：小波去噪评估目标、缺乏朴素持久性基线、最佳N次重复报告。其新意在于方法论审计与修正协议下的重新评估，有助于识别深度学习金融预测中的性能高估来源。
cards.limitationsEn: The study is limited to one-day-ahead closing price forecasting of the S&P 500; applicability to other assets, frequencies, or horizons is unclear. Benchmark models are limited to linear regression, RNN, and LSTM, excluding other model families. Although the corrected protocol controls for three inflation sources, other potential biases are not described in the abstract. Performance conclusions are based on a specific dataset and evaluation metrics.
cards.summaryEn: Using a 2006-2025 dataset with fundamental price data, macroeconomic indicators, and engineered technical features, the study benchmarks linear regression, RNN, and LSTM for one-day-ahead S&P 500 forecasting. The authors identify three sources of result inflation in the literature: wavelet-denoised evaluation targets, absence of a naive persistence baseline, and best-of-N replicate reporting, and re-evaluate all models under a corrected protocol. Factually, the study uses the naive persistence forecast as the primary baseline and reports RMSE, MAPE, and Pearson correlation averaged over 30 independent replicates; the authors' view is that these practices inflate performance and require rigorous control.
cards.limitations: 研究仅针对标普500一日前收盘价预测，结论是否适用于其他资产、频率或预测期限尚不明确；基准模型限于线性回归、RNN和LSTM，未涵盖其他模型族；修正协议虽控制三种膨胀来源，但其他潜在偏差未在摘要中说明；性能结论基于特定数据集和评估指标。
keyPoints: 研究在统一预处理和时间顺序评估流程下比较线性回归、RNN和LSTM对标普500次日收盘价的预测。
作者识别三种结果膨胀来源：小波去噪评估目标、缺少朴素持久性基线、最佳N次重复报告。
修正协议下以朴素持久性预测为主要基线，用RMSE、MAPE和皮尔逊相关系数在30次独立重复上评估。
cards.title: 线性回归、RNN与LSTM预测标普500的严谨基准：识别深度学习金融预测中的性能膨胀来源
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究提供了方法论审计视角，帮助识别深度学习股票预测文献中常见的结果膨胀做法，并强调以朴素持久性基线为参照评估模型改进的必要性，对金融机器学习研究的可复现性和性能比较有参考价值。
cards.summary: 研究使用2006-2025年包含基本面价格、宏观经济指标和工程技术特征的数据，对线性回归、RNN和LSTM进行标普500一日前预测的基准测试。作者指出文献中常见三种结果膨胀来源：小波去噪评估目标、缺少朴素持久性基线、最佳N次重复报告，并在修正协议下重新评估所有模型。事实层面，研究以朴素持久性预测为主要基线，用RMSE、MAPE和皮尔逊相关系数在30次独立重复上报告性能；作者观点是这些做法导致性能膨胀，需严谨控制。
cards.originalTitle: A Methodologically Rigorous Benchmark of Linear Regression,RNN, and LSTM for S&P 500 Forecasting:Identifying Sources of Performance Inflation in Financial DeepLearning
cards.titleEn: A Rigorous Benchmark of Linear Regression, RNN, and LSTM for S&P 500 Forecasting: Identifying Sources of Performance Inflation in Financial Deep
cards.descriptionEn: This study benchmarks linear regression, RNN, and LSTM for one-day-ahead S&P 500 closing price forecasting under a unified preprocessing and chronological evaluation pipeline, and audits three common sources of result inflation: wavelet-denoised evaluation targets, absence of a naive persistence baseline, and best-of-N replicate reporting. Its novelty lies in the methodological audit and re-evaluation under a corrected protocol, helping identify sources of performance overest
keyPointsEn: The study compares linear regression, RNN, and LSTM for one-day-ahead S&P 500 closing price forecasting under a unified preprocessing and chronological evaluation pipeline.
The authors identify three sources of result inflation: wavelet-denoised evaluation targets, absence of a naive persistence baseline, and best-of-N replicate reporting.
Under the corrected protocol, the naive persistence forecast serves as the primary baseline, with RMSE, MAPE, and Pearson correlation evaluated over 30 independent replicates.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study offers a methodological audit perspective to help identify common result inflation practices in deep learning stock prediction literature and emphasizes the need to evaluate model improvement against a naive persistence baseline, providing reference value for reproducibility and performance comparison in financial machine learning research.

cards.description: 提出 SAVIOR 数据策展方法，针对金融文档中垂直文本、嵌入标识、细字条款和退化扫描等高影响失败模式，小样本微调视觉语言模型；并给出结构感知评估指标 PaIRS。该方法在 Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 上实现 0.93 词召回，布局感知 OCR 输出用于文档问答时 F1 达 0.89。
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundary: results are based on a single model (Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct) and the SAVIOR-Train dataset, with no reported cross-model, cross-language, or cross-document-type generalization experiments; the 0.93 word recall and 0.89 F1 are benchmark-specific and cannot be directly extrapolated to other financial OCR settings; the validity of PaIRS requires independent validation; computational cost, annotation cost, and deployment constraints are not discussed.
cards.summaryEn: Fact: SAVIOR is a sample-efficient data curation methodology that targets operationally critical but underrepresented document patterns in financial workflows—vertical/rotated text, logo-embedded vendor names, fine-print regulatory clauses, degraded scans, and complex multi-column layouts—to adapt vision-language models; it also proposes PaIRS, a structure-aware evaluation metric measuring layout fidelity via pairwise spatial relationships between tokens. Experimentally, fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct with SAVIOR-Train achieves 0.93 word recall, and using the layout-aware OCR output as context for document question answering attains 0.89 F1, outperforming open- and closed-source models including GPT-4o, Mistral-OCR, PaddleOCR-VL, and DeepSeek-OCR. Author view: these high-impact failure scenarios constitute a substantial portion of real-world failure cases, and targeted data curation can improve robustness.
cards.limitations: 证据边界：结果基于 Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 单模型和 SAVIOR-Train 数据集，未报告跨模型、跨语言或跨文档类型的泛化实验；0.93 词召回与 0.89 F1 均为特定基准上的数值，不能直接外推至其他金融 OCR 场景；PaIRS 指标的有效性尚需独立验证；论文未讨论计算成本、标注成本或部署约束。
keyPoints: SAVIOR 针对金融 OCR 中公开数据 underrepresented 但操作关键的模式（垂直/旋转文本、标识内嵌名称、细字条款、退化扫描、多栏布局）进行样本高效数据策展。
用 SAVIOR-Train 微调 Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 达到 0.93 词召回，布局感知 OCR 输出用于文档问答时 F1 为 0.89，优于 GPT-4o、Mistral-OCR、PaddleOCR-VL、DeepSeek-OCR。
提出 PaIRS 结构感知评估指标，通过 token 间成对空间关系衡量布局保真度。
cards.title: SAVIOR 小样本适配视觉语言模型提升金融 OCR
cards.whyItMatters: 金融工作流中垂直文本、嵌入标识、细字监管条款和退化扫描等模式虽在公开基准中少见，却是真实失败案例的重要来源。SAVIOR 提供了一种小样本适配路径，并给出布局保真度的量化指标，有助于将 OCR 评估从字符准确率扩展到结构层面；但结论基于特定模型与数据集，跨场景泛化仍需验证。
cards.summary: 事实：SAVIOR 是一种样本高效的数据策展方法，针对金融工作流中操作关键但公开数据集少见的文档模式（如垂直/旋转文本、标识内嵌厂商名、细字监管条款、退化扫描、复杂多栏布局）适配视觉语言模型；同时提出 PaIRS 结构感知指标，通过比较 token 间成对空间关系衡量布局保真度。实验上，用 SAVIOR-Train 微调 Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct 达到 0.93 词召回；将布局感知 OCR 输出作为文档问答上下文时 F1 为 0.89，优于 GPT-4o、Mistral-OCR、PaddleOCR-VL 和 DeepSeek-OCR 等开源与闭源模型。作者观点：这些高影响失败场景在真实失败案例中占显著比例，针对性的数据策展可提升鲁棒性。
cards.originalTitle: SAVIOR: Sample-efficient Adaptation of Vision-Language Models for OCR Representation
cards.titleEn: SAVIOR: Sample-Efficient Adaptation of Vision-Language Models for Financial OCR
cards.descriptionEn: SAVIOR is a data curation method targeting high-impact failure patterns in financial documents (vertical/rotated text, logo-embedded names, fine-print clauses, degraded scans, complex multi-column layouts) to adapt vision-language models with few samples; it also introduces PaIRS, a structure-aware metric. Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct yields 0.93 word recall, and using the layout-aware OCR output as context for document QA achieves 0.89 F1.
keyPointsEn: SAVIOR performs sample-efficient data curation targeting operationally critical but publicly underrepresented OCR patterns in finance: vertical/rotated text, logo-embedded names, fine-print clauses, degraded scans, and multi-column layouts.

Fine-tuning Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct with SAVIOR-Train achieves 0.93 word recall; using the layout-aware OCR output for document QA attains 0.89 F1, outperforming GPT-4o, Mistral-OCR, PaddleOCR-VL, and DeepSeek-OCR.
Introduces PaIRS, a structure-aware evaluation metric that measures layout fidelity via pairwise spatial relationships between tokens.
cards.whyItMattersEn: Patterns such as vertical text, embedded logos, fine-print regulatory clauses, and degraded scans are rare in public benchmarks yet account for many real-world failures in financial workflows. SAVIOR offers a few-shot adaptation path and a quantitative layout-fidelity metric, helping extend OCR evaluation beyond character accuracy to structure; however, generalization beyond the studied model and dataset remains to be verified.

cards.description: 该研究利用1996—2018年美国49州8,875家公司的数据，发现社会信任水平较高的地区，彩票型股票（以MAX为代理）的MAX效应（高MAX股票后续收益较低）更集中；信任较低的地区该效应微弱甚至不存在。新意在于将社会信任识别为彩票型股票定价的一个新型决定因素，并提示社会资本可能放大信念驱动的错误定价。
cards.limitationsEn: The sample is limited to 8,875 US firms across 49 states from 1996–2018, so external validity should be treated with caution; MAX is used as a proxy for lottery-like characteristics and alternative proxies, while tested, may not capture all such attributes; social trust is correlated with regional education and income, and the trust-conditioning mechanism is the authors' proposed explanation rather than a directly identified causal channel; the results rely on observational data and cannot rule out omitted variables or reverse causality.
cards.summaryEn: The authors argue that higher social trust reduces investors' skepticism toward optimistic information about extreme future payoffs, increasing demand for lottery-like stocks and leading to overpricing and lower subsequent returns. Using a sample of 8,875 firms across 49 US states over 1996–2018, they show that the MAX effect is concentrated in high-trust regions and weak or absent in low-trust regions, with this trust conditioning stronger in lower-education or lower-income areas. These are the authors' empirical findings, while the belief-channel explanation that social trust amplifies mispricing is the authors' interpretive view.
cards.limitations: 样本限于1996—2018年美国49州8,875家公司，结论的外部有效性需谨慎对待；研究使用MAX作为彩票型特征的代理，替代代理虽经检验但未必覆盖全部彩票型属性；社会信任与地区教育、收入等变量相关，信任调节机制为作者提出的解释而非直接识别的因果渠道；结果基于观察性数据，不能排除遗漏变量或反向因果等替代解释。
keyPoints: MAX效应在信任较高的地区集中，在信任较低的地区微弱或不存在。
信任调节作用在教育和收入水平较低的地区更强，作者将其解释为私人信息获取受限时社会信任更重要。
结果对替代彩票代理变量和多项稳健性检验保持稳健。
cards.title: 社会信任如何加剧彩票型股票的错误定价
cards.whyItMatters: 该研究将社会信任引入彩票型股票定价分析，提示仅按MAX等特征构建的异象收益可能随地区社会信任水平而变化，为理解信念驱动型错误定价提供了新的横截面维度。
cards.summary: 作者认为，社会信任降低投资者对极端未来收益相关乐观信息的怀疑，从而推高彩票型股票需求并导致其被高估、后续收益偏低。基于1996—2018年美国49州8,875家公司的样本，作者发现MAX效应集中在信任较高的地区，在信任较低的地区微弱或不存在；这种信任调节在教育和收入水平较低的地区更强。上述发现为作者的实证结论，而“社会信任通过信念渠道放大错误定价”是作者提出的解释性观点。
cards.titleEn: How Social Trust Amplifies Mispricing of Lottery-Like Stocks
cards.descriptionEn: Using data on 8,875 firms across 49 US states from 1996 to 2018, the study finds that the MAX effect (lower subsequent returns for high-MAX stocks) is concentrated in high-trust regions and is weak or absent in low-trust regions. Its novelty lies in identifying social trust as a novel determinant of lottery-like stock pricing and suggesting that social capital may amplify belief-driven mispricing.
keyPointsEn: The MAX effect is concentrated in high-trust regions and weak or absent in low-trust regions.
The trust conditioning is stronger in lower-education or lower-income regions, which the authors interpret as social trust mattering more when access to private information is limited.
Results are robust to alternative lottery proxies and a range of robustness checks.
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study introduces social trust into the analysis of lottery-like stock pricing, suggesting that anomaly returns built on characteristics such as MAX may vary with regional social trust and offering a new cross-sectional dimension for understanding belief-driven mispricing.

cards.description: 该仓库提供一套遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准的技能库，用于与 Stitch MCP 服务器配合。其新意在于技能以开放标准封装，可跨 Antigravity、Gemini CLI、Claude Code、Cursor 等编码智能体复用。
cards.limitationsEn: The source is only a brief description from GitHub Trending Daily and provides no information on the number of skills, specific features, compatibility verification methods, or actual usage results. The compatibility claims come from the project's own description and have not been independently verified.
cards.summaryEn: The repository releases a set of Agent Skills designed for the Stitch MCP server, with each skill following the Agent Skills open standard. The source states compatibility with coding agents including Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, and Cursor.
cards.limitations: 来源仅为 GitHub Trending Daily 的简要描述，未提供技能数量、具体功能、兼容性验证方法或实际使用效果；兼容性声明来自项目自述，未经独立验证。
